description: The entity does not have procedures for resolving disputes related to privacy. This signal indicates that the organization lacks formal mechanisms to address disagreements or conflicts with data subjects regarding privacy practices, potentially leading to escalated conflicts and regulatory issues.
applicability: Applicable to privacy dispute resolution processes, escalation procedures, privacy team operations, legal and compliance functions, and alternative dispute resolution mechanisms.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of dispute resolution procedures, escalation protocols, privacy policy commitments, and complaint handling documentation. May be identified by absence of formal dispute processes, missing escalation paths, or lack of alternative resolution mechanisms.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
